text:
Izumi Saito: Hey everyone — I'm Izumi, joining eng-ml from Tokyo (remote PST mornings). I bring bento-level lunch skills and a small bonsai. First day badge pickup? :wave:
Mira Patel: welcome Izumi!! excited to have you. badge pickup is at 10am at front desk. I'll grab coffee and introduce you to the rooftop plants :) :coffee:
Arjun Patel: hi Izumi! if you want a desk plant starter kit ping me. also @Izumi Saito what timezone offset are you on? (I can schedule a sync)
Izumi Saito: Thanks @Mira @Arjun! I'm JST (UTC+9) but I'll be online 6pm-2am UTC for the first week. happy to swap bonsai tips. also I have a strict bento reheating protocol — don't put seaweed in the microwave :grimacing:
Tess - People Ops: Welcome! HR scheduled onboarding at 11:15 (calendar invite sent). Lunch meetup at 12:30 in the kitchen (we have a 'first-day dessert' tradition). :confetti_ball:
Evan Cohen: welcome Izumi :tada: we do a quick 'two truths' intro at lunch, bring your best one-liner.
Izumi Saito: Two truths: I once trained a cat to fetch a rice ball, and I can fold an origami crane blindfolded. ;)
Mira Patel: perfect :laughing: see you at 12:30. also rooftop is plant-safe — you can drop off the bonsai there after badge pickup.
welcome-bot: New hire welcome pack has been issued to Izumi Saito. (masking: #starter-plant, mug) :package:
Arjun Patel: if you want to join the snack roster, we do alternating bagel/bento Fridays. vote with :bagel: or :bento: reactions!
Izumi Saito: bagel please :bagel:
Evan Cohen: :bagel: noted. welcome aboard!
